markdown: **Activate** <actions string="Three Actions" /> command, envision, Interact;  **Frequency** once per day;   **Effect** You call upon a loyal subject to aid you by holding _The Queen Mother_ out and asking her to send help. You cast [_summon animal_](/Spells.aspx?ID=316) or [_summon construct_](/Spells.aspx?ID=318), but with a range of 90 feet. The level of the spell is one-half your level rounded down.
